historical_references.reference: Sarfaraz Khan, a famous Mughal general in the late 16th century, served under Akbar. He was known for his valor and military skills. In 1576, he led the Mughal army to conquer Malwa and later, in 1583, he assisted Akbar in the Siege of Chittorgarh.

Sarfaraz Nawab, a powerful Pathan ruler in South India during the late 17th and early 18th centuries, ruled over the areas around Madurai. He was a vassal of the Nayak rulers of Thanjavur and expanded his territories through military conquests. In 1674, he successfully resisted the attempts of the Maratha forces to invade his lands.
